10 استوثر الفِرَاشَ He found, or deemed, the bed smooth, soft, or easy to lie upon. (A, * TA.) ―
-b2- إِذَا تَزَوَّجْتَ ٱمْرَأَةٌ فَٱسْتَوْثِرْهَا (tropical:) [When thou takest a woman as thy wife, choose her fat, suitable for a bedfellow: see وَثِيرٌ]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
